title: Signal: MongoDB HTTP interface disclosed
scope: One response whose body carries the HTTP-over-native-port message.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the port reply; it does not speak the wire protocol and cannot show whether authentication is enforced.

observation.body:
MongoDB

It looks like you are trying to access MongoDB over HTTP on the native driver port.
